advisory_en: HAUZ KHAS: flood probability 83% — risk level HIGH. Flagged at this risk level since 05:30 IST. Highest probability so far at 12:30 IST. About 90,171 residents are in the exposed area, with 5 hospital(s), 5 school(s) and 56.5 km of road. Main drivers: near an underpass, rainfall today, dense built-up. 1 pump(s) are mapped in this ward.
